title: Quietly Indulgent Croatian Vegetable Pasta
description: Savor the rich flavors of Croatia in this indulgent vegetarian pasta dish, featuring a velvety emulsion sauce infused with the goodness of local vegetables.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced zucchini and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the crushed canned tomatoes and vegetable broth, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, while the pasta finishes cooking.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the pappardelle, then add the pasta to the skillet with the sauce.
Toss the pasta in the sauce, adding some reserved pasta water if the sauce seems too thick, until the pasta is well coated.
Stir in the grated grana padano cheese until melted and well combined.
Season the pasta with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
